phases.label: Planning
phases.summary: Understand the topic, agree the scope and prepare the work program.

phases.label: Gathering
phases.summary: Ask people, request documents, and match what arrives to the test it belongs to.

phases.label: Fieldwork
phases.summary: Test controls, gather evidence and record observations.

phases.label: Reporting
phases.summary: Turn observations into findings and the audit report.

phases.label: Quality
phases.summary: Cross-cutting checks you can run at any point.

nodes.label: Topic Intelligence
nodes.description: Scans regulation, supervisory publications and public signals to explain the topic and propose key risk areas.

nodes.label: Frameworks & Requirements
nodes.description: Maps the laws, regulations and internal frameworks that apply and extracts testable requirements.

nodes.label: Process Understanding
nodes.description: Drafts the process walkthrough and preliminary observations.

nodes.label: Scope & Objectives
nodes.description: Proposes in-scope and out-of-scope areas and the key audit questions.

nodes.label: Background Risk Assessment
nodes.description: Drafts the background risk assessment for the areas in scope.

nodes.label: Audit Notification Letter
nodes.description: Drafts the audit notification letter, with an AI review before sign-off.

nodes.label: Kick-off
nodes.description: Prepares the kick-off meeting agenda.

nodes.label: Resource Planning
nodes.description: Confirms dates, hours and the team for the engagement.

nodes.label: Interview Guide
nodes.description: Generates persona-based interview guides traceable to risks and requirements.

nodes.label: Work Program
nodes.description: Generates the test program from scope and risks. Your sign-off unlocks fieldwork.

nodes.label: Document Request List
nodes.description: Builds the document request list for the auditee.

nodes.label: Interview Companion
nodes.description: A live companion during interviews that turns answers into follow-ups, observations and minutes.

nodes.label: Coverage check
nodes.description: Checks that every in-scope area really has risks, controls and tests behind it — so nothing you promised to cover is left unexamined.

nodes.label: AI QA review
nodes.description: Reviews each drafted artefact for quality before anyone relies on it, and flags what must be fixed against what is merely a suggestion.

nodes.label: AI peer review (GIAS)
nodes.description: An independent second opinion on the whole engagement, scored criterion by criterion against the Global Internal Audit Standards. It rates only what the file actually evidences — anything not produced reads as 'not evidenced', never as a pass. It proposes the ratings; a human peer reviewer confirms them.

nodes.label: RACM scoping
nodes.description: Builds the objective → risk → control → test spine from scope and the risk assessment.

nodes.label: Governance assessment
nodes.description: Assesses governance documents against the applicable frameworks and proposes gaps as risks.

nodes.label: Data analysis
nodes.description: Runs full-population checks on the data and proposes exceptions as tests.

nodes.label: Evidence chase
nodes.description: Matches every document that arrives to the test it belongs to, and keeps a running list of the evidence still outstanding.

nodes.label: Fieldwork
nodes.description: Record findings, recommendations, good practices and improvements.

nodes.label: Findings (5C)
nodes.description: Turns observations into 5C findings. A second agent challenges each rating.

nodes.label: Audit report
nodes.description: Assembles the audit report and overall opinion for your approval.

nodes.label: Supervisory Guidance
nodes.description: Searches supervisory guidance relevant to the topic and jurisdictions.

nodes.label: RCSA import
nodes.description: Reads the risk and control self-assessment the business made about itself. An agent proposes what each column of the export holds, you confirm it once, and the next import from the same template is one click.

nodes.label: PBC assistant
nodes.description: PBC stands for Prepared By Client: the documents the auditee has to deliver. Tracks every request, drafts the distribution email and the reminders, and checks each document as it comes in.

nodes.label: Privacy Guard
nodes.description: Detects personal data, classifies it per audit purpose and masks or pseudonymises it by role.

nodes.label: Vendor Guard
nodes.description: Assesses a third party against 8 curated EU/NL frameworks and proposes critical gaps into the matrix.

human_gates.label: Accept scope items and key audit questions
Sign off the Work Program — this unlocks Fieldwork
Accept or dismiss AI proposals in the matrix
Confirm each finding and its rating
